name: huit-maestro
description: Ask Claude about HUIT's Maestro (IBM Workload Automation) scheduler: jobstream status, why a job is waiting or failed, run history, who submitted an ad-hoc job, PagerDuty and ServiceNow linkage, and the engine-side log of a run. Read-only, via the Maestro Utility MCP server. Authentication is a HarvardKey login in your browser through /mcp; no token, client ID, or secret to distribute.
